description: The chromed half-collar the Curators wear, issued rather than sold — a ring of pattern-grade sensor weave that sits behind the neck and reads the room a half-second before you do. It isn't subtle and isn't meant to be. On this campus it's a uniform. In Coldwater it's a statement somebody else has to decide how to take.

failure_messages.burnout: The collar browns out and the room goes flat and simultaneous, every sound arriving at once with equal weight.
failure_messages.dead: The halo collar dulls, goes grey, and becomes a heavy ring of scrap you're wearing on your spine.
failure_messages.fault: The collar drops half a second behind and hands you a room you were standing in a moment ago.
failure_messages.strain: The collar runs hot against the back of your neck and the room arrives a half-second LATE. You would see more with the collar off.

name: Halcyon Halo Collar
